newsitem.title: KENYA: Embassy says Belgian pleads guilty in minors case.
newsitem.headline: Embassy says Belgian pleads guilty in minors case.

text.p: A Belgian man accused of immoral behaviour with minors has pleaded guilty in a Rwandan court, a Belgian embassy diplomat in Kigali said on Friday.
Jean-Marc Segers will be sentenced next week but the exact date has not been announced, the diplomat, who declined to be quoted by name, told Reuters in Nairobi by telephone.
"The trial was held on Thursday in camera. Mr Segers pleaded guilty," the diplomat said.
He said Segers had lived in the former Belgian protectorate for several years and worked for the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) office in Kigali.
He said he did not know the sentence requested by the state prosecutor and declined to give any other details about the case.
